title: Taku island extras v1
description: Version 1 source contract; ROM/device acceptance is tracked separately in docs/dynamic-island-progress.md. Duplicate keys and nesting deeper than eight levels are rejected. JSON carried in Notification extras["taku.island.v1"] (UTF-8, at most 8192 bytes). Images are keys into extras["taku.island.pics"] (Bundle<String, Icon>); actions are keys into extras["taku.island.actions"] (Bundle<String, Notification.Action>). SystemUI renders all content natively from these slots; no HTML, scripts, loadable URLs or custom views. Invalid extras are ignored and the notification falls back to the Android Live Update / normal notification presentation. See docs/dynamic-island-architecture.md.

category.description: Arbitration class. call > alarm > recording > navigation > timer > assistant > media > progress > other. call and alarm are reserved for system sources and rejected from other producers.

relevance.description: Ordering within a category; higher first, then most recent.

bigIsland.description: Compact state: the two halves left and right of the camera cutout. At least one side must have content.

smallIsland.description: Single-glyph form used when the item is the secondary island. Defaults to bigIsland.leading if it is a pic, else the notification small icon.

compact.description: Assistant compact UI requires explicit building; hidden suppresses it. Legacy assistant publishers default to hidden.

statusBar.description: Advisory hint for the expanded card. The host decides: automatic alerts sit below the status bar; explicit taps may cover it unless IME or host policy requires below-bar mode.

alert.description: A false-to-true transition briefly auto-expands below the status bar for at most five seconds; repeated true updates do not extend it. Calls/alarms and heads-up remain higher priority.

islandTimeoutS.description: Island lifetime from the first post; the host also enforces an 8 h cap.

staleAfterS.description: Without an update for this long the item is shown as stale and drops in rank.

animated.description: Host-provided animation for well-known glyphs (e.g. working dots); ignored for producer images.

timerSlot.description: Count-up from startEpochMs (calls, recording). Rendered by the host every second; producers need not re-post.

expanded.description: Expanded card content. The template is rendered natively; content.service optionally supplies a richer body as an embedded surface, with the template as loading/failure fallback.

actions.description: Keys into extras["taku.island.actions"], in display order; at most one is primary.

primaryAction.description: Must name an entry in expanded.actions; checked by the native parser.

assistant.description: Native SystemUI assistant card. suggestions contains only model-provided option action IDs; no suggested prompts are fabricated. Cannot be combined with remote content.

content.description: Optional rich body from a separate content-host process (SurfaceControlViewHost). The service must be exported, protected by a signature permission and belong to the posting package.

token.description: Opaque producer token passed to the service (e.g. a thread id); never interpreted by SystemUI.

layout.description: body embeds content inside the native shell; card supplies its own header and actions.

heightDp.description: Requested card height; SystemUI also caps it to the available screen area.
